title: AI Evaluation Science Lab
description: How far can an AI evaluator be trusted? Reliability statistics beyond kappa, LLM-judge bias tests (position, verbosity, self-preference), sample sizes for judge validation and system comparison, drift monitoring with CUSUM, Goodhart effects, and a judge acceptance test in CI. No API key needed.
notes: Code is licensed under MIT; the written material (articles/) is licensed under CC BY 4.0. The systems, raters, judges and data are simulated.
